name: EPIC 210368383
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 4, 16.4 solar radii and 2.08 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 210368383 (K2 campaign 4): PARAM radius (solar radii) 16.394685 (16th-84th percentiles 15.336581-17.319184), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 3,448 parsecs away, 16 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 4, give 2.08 solar masses and 16.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,909 K at its surface.
